issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change despite conventions requiring tests for every feature plus unauthorized-call and tamper tests for each Livewire action.
issues.location: tests/* (missing — no test files in change.diff)

issues.explanation: assignRole does not reject the owner membership as target, so an owner/admin can demote the sole owner to admin/employee leaving zero owners and breaking the exactly-one-owner invariant.
Domain writes (addMember, assignRole, removeMember, save, delete, transfer) are implemented directly in Livewire components instead of app/Actions/* one-class-per-use-case required by conventions.
Settings public name/slug/targetMembershipId lack #[Validate] attributes and assignRole uses Validator::make inline instead of the project's #[Validate] + $this->validate() pattern.

conventions.evidence: Policies for auth (app/Policies/*, Gate::policy), $fillable set, reversible migrations, Blade {{ }} escaping, Bulma classes, docs/database-schema.md + CHANGELOG.md updated; deviations: no app/Actions/* for domain writes, Settings lacks #[Validate] (uses $this->validate([...])), assignRole uses Validator::make

readability.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:124-194, app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:244-315: small focused methods, clear names, sibling style; minor inconsistency in validation style

requirements.evidence: entities_slug_unique + SoftDeletes + getRouteKeyName slug (app/Models/Entity.php), owner_seq + entity_memberships_one_owner (change.diff:800-801), policies match spec, EntityPickController.php:32-45 session/audit/redirect, Dashboard/Members/Settings mount + actions, routes/web.php:1101-1115, lang/*/ui.php owner/transfer strings; edge gap: assignRole can demote owner to zero-owner state

scope.evidence: All hunks serve task (models, policies, picker, Livewire pages, routes, lang, docs/database-schema.md, CHANGELOG.md); no onboarding, switcher, session-guard, locale middleware, navbar, billing, or restore logic

security.evidence: $this->authorize in every Livewire action, #[Locked] Entity in Dashboard/Members/Settings, scoped memberships()->findOrFail/find, {{ }} escaping, role fixed to Employee on create, in:admin,employee validation; gap: assignRole missing owner-target guard allows zero-owner state

simplicity.evidence: Direct Eloquent + policies + DB::transaction for transfer/delete, no service layers or speculative abstractions, reuses memberships() relation and UserRole enum

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/* or Pest files; no happy-path, validation-failure, unauthorized-call, or tamper tests for picker or Livewire actions

review.summary: Implements the full entity data model, policies, picker, and Livewire pages with correct auth scoping and docs. Missing tests entirely and allows demoting the owner via assignRole, so it needs substantial rework before merging.
